summary: Leef Brands completed its acquisition of Standard Holdings (SHI) via a merger of a wholly owned subsidiary (Merger Sub) into SHI, with SHI surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary. Consideration: 12,592,960 Leef common shares to SHI senior preferred stockholders and $10,000 cash to common/series seed holders. SHI stock options/warrants were cancelled for no consideration. Merger shares are subject to a 12-month lock-up releasing one-third every 4 months. Leef retained certain SHI executive officers. No listed premium, pricing, or advisor names. Watch for lock-up expirations and integration execution.
